name: Hermes DKG Memory Bridge
description: Hermes crypto agent action audit trail + decision recall on DKG V10 memory. Records on-chain actions (swap, bridge, mint, deploy) as provenance-tagged Knowledge Assets in DKG Working/Shared Memory, forming an immutable, queryable audit trail. Enables decision recall via SPARQL queries.

install.usageHint: Run 'hermes-dkg status' to check DKG node status, 'hermes-dkg audit <action-json>' to record a Hermes action to DKG WM.

security.notes: The bridge performs no signing and no publishing; recording is a post-execution step, so the existing Hermes security model (user-funds-only, confirm-before-sign, Spend Governor) is untouched. Secrets are redacted before leaving the process. No external network egress: the only host contacted is the DKG node it is installed against (127.0.0.1 by default), which the registry contract does not count as egress. No vm/publish in Round 1 scope.

promotionPath: Actions recorded to Working Memory can be promoted to Shared Working Memory only via the explicit 'hermes-dkg promote <ka>' command (swm/share, seals by default). There is no automatic promotion and no daemon; VM publishing is not implemented in Round 1.
fitNotes: Hermes-specific action audit trail: each executed action is recorded as a provenance-tagged KA with canonical parameters and a params hash. Designed as a post-execution recorder: an action dispatcher invokes the bridge after execution; the bridge never signs transactions and never publishes. Decision recall via SPARQL lets the agent review prior actions before proposing new ones.
